summary: Final RBAC verification completed against the public URL. Backend regression passed 54/54, including prescription privacy for assistant, front_desk, and legacy receptionist plus doctor visibility; all requested role boundaries, sub-user limits, Sarah role migration, admin login API, Hexa, transcription, reminders, patient portal, and invoices passed. Frontend dedicated /admin/login now reaches AdminLayout without refresh, standard /login admin redirect passes, Doctor/Front Desk/Assistant badges and navigation pass, and Clinic Settings copy is clean. One additional security regression was found: AdminLayout logout leaves AuthContext authenticated, so browser Back restores the protected admin dashboard and API-backed data until reload.

integration_issues.issue: After AdminLayout Logout navigates to /admin/login, browser Back restores /admin/dashboard with live dashboard data. The SPA AuthContext token/user and axios Authorization header remain active until a full reload.

action_items: Refactor AdminLayout logout to call AuthContext.logout() (and use replace navigation) so React user/token state, axios Authorization, token storage, and user storage are cleared; verify browser Back cannot reopen /admin/dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout.handleLogout bypasses AuthContext and only removes localStorage keys. ProtectedRoute still sees the in-memory admin user, and axios retains its bearer header, allowing SPA history navigation back into authenticated admin content.

server.py remains a 3,500+ line module and static analysis reports seven bare-except blocks, which can suppress authentication/integration failures and should be replaced with explicit exceptions and logging.

success_rate.frontend: 86% (6/7 high-level flows passed; all requested fix flows passed, additional admin logout/back security flow failed)

seed_data_creation: Pytest created an isolated TEST_RBAC clinic, assistant, front_desk, legacy receptionist, appointments/clients, invoices, notes, and prescriptions; teardown removed all. UI created one isolated clinic plus assistant/front_desk accounts for badge tests and removed all, including the orphan clinic from an initial selector-only test failure.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The three iteration_9 defects are verified fixed. Re-run the admin logout SPA history case after changing AdminLayout: login via /admin/login, click [data-testid='admin-logout-btn'], then browser Back; expected to remain on a login route. Backend iteration_10 suite is green at 54/54.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: log in at /admin/login, click AdminLayout Logout, then use browser Back. /admin/dashboard and live metrics return. RCA: AdminLayout.handleLogout directly deletes localStorage and navigates, but does not invoke AuthContext.logout(); therefore React user/token state and axios.defaults Authorization remain valid in the current SPA document. A full page navigation hides the issue by remounting AuthProvider without the stored token, but SPA history exposes it.
